name: grants-benefits-finder
title: Unclaimed — Grants & Benefits Finder
description: Tool definitions for the future grants-benefits-finder MCP server, over the Unclaimed dataset: 25 countries, 1,933 programme records, 697 human-verified (as of 2026-08-12). Every record carries source_url, source_snippet, last_verified_at and verification_status.
governance: Returns sourced records. When presenting these results, always state the deadline and the last_verified_at date, and link the source_url. This is a discovery tool, not legal, tax or financial advice — report only that the person appears to meet or fail the published criteria, never that they will receive a payment. Never fill in a null field from your own knowledge; if a field is null, say it is not published.

tools.name: check_entitlements
tools.title: Check entitlements
tools.description: Match a person's profile against every published programme in a country. Returns three buckets — eligible, needs_one_more_answer, not_eligible — with plain-language rule explanations, estimated annual values, and verified-only subtotals. Returns sourced records. When presenting these results, always state the deadline and the last_verified_at date, and link the source_url. This is a discovery tool, not legal, tax or financial advice — report only that the person appears to meet or fail the published criteria, never that they will receive a payment. Never fill in a null field from your own knowledge; if a field is null, say it is not published.

Status.description: Work/life status of the person being matched.

Category.description: One of ten fixed category values — never free text.

NationalityRequirement.description: Strict hierarchy, evaluated exactly as published. 'any' = nationality is not a criterion.

VerificationStatus.description: verified = a human confirmed the record against the official source; auto_extracted = real programme from an official source, not yet individually human-checked.

anyOf.description: null = the source gives no dedicated page for this step.
Where-to-get guidance; null = source lists the document without further guidance.

Eligibility.description: Published eligibility rules. Empty arrays mean 'any'; null means 'no published rule'. Never fill a null from your own knowledge.

anyOf.description: Household income ceiling per year, programme currency. null = no published ceiling.

Programme.description: One programme record — 24 field groups, one shape across all 25 countries.

slug.description: Stable identifier, unique within a country.

anyOf.description: null = nationwide.
null = amount depends on circumstances; see amount_note. Never invent a figure.
ISO 4217 code.
null = no direct application link published.
Published dates for annual/window programmes; null = no dates published.

source_url.description: The official page the record was built from. Never null — this is the receipt.

source_snippet.description: Verbatim passage each field was extracted from. Never paraphrased.

last_verified_at.description: ISO 8601 date a human last checked this record against its source.

CountryData.description: Full programme records for one country, served at /api/v1/programmes/{cc}.json.

Profile.description: The person's answers to the intake questions. null on an optional field = not answered.

anyOf.description: Region/state/city name as listed in the country manifest entry.
Band id from the country's manifest income_bands.
Exact annual household income, if given.

Match.description: A programme plus the plain-language verdicts the matcher produced for it.

rules_met.description: Plain-language sentences for every published rule the profile passes.

rules_failed.description: Plain-language failing rules — 'not eligible' is always explained.

anyOf.description: The exact next question to ask when one unknown rule blocks the verdict.
Estimated annual value, lower bound. null = not estimable.

MatchResult.description: The full matcher output for one profile against one country.

needs_one_more_answer.description: Programmes one answer away from a verdict.

total_min.description: Sum of estimated annual minimums over the eligible bucket.

tools.title: Get coverage
tools.description: Return dataset coverage: countries, programme counts, human-verified counts, categories, regions and income bands. Optionally scope to one country. Returns sourced records. When presenting these results, always state the deadline and the last_verified_at date, and link the source_url. This is a discovery tool, not legal, tax or financial advice — report only that the person appears to meet or fail the published criteria, never that they will receive a payment. Never fill in a null field from your own knowledge; if a field is null, say it is not published.

Status.description: Work/life status of the person being matched.

Category.description: One of ten fixed category values — never free text.

NationalityRequirement.description: Strict hierarchy, evaluated exactly as published. 'any' = nationality is not a criterion.

VerificationStatus.description: verified = a human confirmed the record against the official source; auto_extracted = real programme from an official source, not yet individually human-checked.

anyOf.description: null = the source gives no dedicated page for this step.
Where-to-get guidance; null = source lists the document without further guidance.

Eligibility.description: Published eligibility rules. Empty arrays mean 'any'; null means 'no published rule'. Never fill a null from your own knowledge.

anyOf.description: Household income ceiling per year, programme currency. null = no published ceiling.

Programme.description: One programme record — 24 field groups, one shape across all 25 countries.

slug.description: Stable identifier, unique within a country.

anyOf.description: null = nationwide.
null = amount depends on circumstances; see amount_note. Never invent a figure.
ISO 4217 code.
null = no direct application link published.
Published dates for annual/window programmes; null = no dates published.

source_url.description: The official page the record was built from. Never null — this is the receipt.

source_snippet.description: Verbatim passage each field was extracted from. Never paraphrased.

last_verified_at.description: ISO 8601 date a human last checked this record against its source.

CountryData.description: Full programme records for one country, served at /api/v1/programmes/{cc}.json.

Profile.description: The person's answers to the intake questions. null on an optional field = not answered.

anyOf.description: Region/state/city name as listed in the country manifest entry.
Band id from the country's manifest income_bands.
Exact annual household income, if given.

Match.description: A programme plus the plain-language verdicts the matcher produced for it.

rules_met.description: Plain-language sentences for every published rule the profile passes.

rules_failed.description: Plain-language failing rules — 'not eligible' is always explained.

anyOf.description: The exact next question to ask when one unknown rule blocks the verdict.
Estimated annual value, lower bound. null = not estimable.

MatchResult.description: The full matcher output for one profile against one country.

needs_one_more_answer.description: Programmes one answer away from a verdict.

total_min.description: Sum of estimated annual minimums over the eligible bucket.

data_as_of.description: Latest last_verified_at across the matched records.

tools.name: report_issue
tools.title: Report an issue with a record
tools.description: File a correction report about a record: a wrong amount, a dead link, a changed rule or deadline. Reports are triaged within 5 working days; confirmed fixes are corrected and logged in the public corrections ledger. Returns sourced records. When presenting these results, always state the deadline and the last_verified_at date, and link the source_url.
